text:
ops-bot: Pager: high queue depth on /v1/generate in us-west-2 - 95th latency spike, errors increasing, autoscaler failing to add nodes :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Automatic incident created INC-2026-0454 - Severity: P1. Notifying oncall.

alisha: looking. I see a bunch of preemptible GPUs lost last 12m, pool size dropped from 48 -> 12 because spot terminations + autoscaler didn't pass scale-up due to policy limits.

maria: linkage to dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/serve/queue?orgId=1&var-cluster=us-west-2 - queue growth visible starting 15:32 UTC.

alisha: paste logs from autoscaler:
```
2026-03-14T15:34:02Z INFO scale_decision: desired_instances=60
2026-03-14T15:34:02Z WARN cloud_api: quota_exceeded: Requested 12 GPUs, account limit 8
2026-03-14T15:34:03Z ERROR autoscaler: scaleup_failed: policy_limit_hit
```

raj: ohhh our cloud account soft limit on p4d was 8, we didn't request increase. Spot interruption took out most nodes, and autoscaler wanted to spin up on-demand but hit account limit.

tom: customer impact? how many requests failing or throttled?

alisha: current metrics: 5m avg queue length 9k requests, error rate for /v1/generate 18% (primarily 429 throttles and 503s), tail latency > 10s for many in-flight. Affects ~20% of production traffic for hosted tier in us-west-2.

maria: initial mitigation options: 1) enable dedicated on-demand fallback pool in us-west-2 (we have reserved capacity in dedicated-usw2 but not attached), 2) escalate quota increase with cloud provider, 3) temporarily reroute new requests to other regions (us-east-1) with cross-region routing policy, 4) enable aggressive shedding for low-priority customers.

alisha: doing option 1 + 3 in parallel. I'm attaching the dedicated pool to the serving group now.

alisha: running command to attach pool:
```
# attach dedicated pool to model-route
redwoodctl pool attach --pool dedicated-usw2-a --route /v1/generate --autoscale false
```

ops-bot: Deploy job started: attach-pool-job-1763504230

alisha: attach job logs: attached 16 GPUs from dedicated pool, routing rules updated. Rebalancing KV caches may take a minute.

maria: spun up cross-region failover: set routing policy threshold=queue>1500 -> route to us-east-1.

tom: routing looks good, traffic diffing shows 30% new requests shifted to us-east. Latencies there within SLO.

alisha: still seeing backlog ~4k but errors dropping from 18% -> 6% as new capacity comes in.

raj: What prevented autoscaler from using dedicated pool earlier? Runbook step?

maria: config shows autoscaler.allow_fallback=false for this route due to earlier cost control experiment. That prevented automatic fallback to dedicated. We need to revisit default for critical endpoints.

alisha: creating short-term override to allow fallback in policy and bump max_instances to 100 for the region.

alisha: policy override command:
```
redwoodctl policy update --route /v1/generate --allow_fallback true --max_instances 100
```

ops-bot: Policy update applied by alisha.

eng-sre: FYI I'm going to open a runbook PR to make fallback allowed by default for hosted-api routes with SLO > 99.

tom: customers to notify? Which tenants saw errors?

alisha: top impacted tenants (by request volume): acme-inc (5% traffic), nimble-ai (3%), internal-dev (2%). Incident severity mapping: acme-inc partial outage for a 30m window; we'll notify account team.

maria: creating support ticket/template: "Service interruption in us-west-2 impacting generation calls; mitigation in progress; expected degraded service for up to 1 hour while backfill finishes."

incident-bot: PagerDuty note posted. Handoff scheduled.

alisha: handing off to tom for overlap 10m, I need to triage cloud quota escalation - going to call infra support.

tom: taking over. Current actions: monitor queue until <500, watch error rate <1%, ensure KV cache warmup finishes. Also confirm dedicated pool won't saturate CPU/GPU memory.

tom: quick check of node health: some attached GPUs in dedicated pool report lower cudnn version; running verification job:
```
redwoodctl healthcheck --pool dedicated-usw2-a
pool: dedicated-usw2-a
nodes: 16
healthy: 15
notes: 1 node had driver mismatch, will be cordoned and replaced.
```

raj: cordon that node. We'll exclude it from routing to avoid OOMs.

ops-bot: Node cordon initiated by raj.

tom: queue down to 600 and error rate 1.9%. Still seeing infrequent 503 for large seq requests because prefix cache warmup not complete. Adding warmcache priority for hot prefixes.

maria: issuing cache-warm command to seed top 200 prompt prefixes from logs to KV cache on new pool.

alisha: cloud support response: quota increase request acknowledged; expected provisioning ETA 2-3 hours. So fallback + routing was the right short-term move.

tom: TL;DR impact assessment for INC-2026-0454: root cause chain: spot/preemptible GPU mass interruption -> autoscaler attempted scale-up but hit cloud account GPU quota limits and a config that disallowed fallback to dedicated on-demand pool -> queue growth and client-side throttles -> partial outage for some hosted customers in us-west-2.

tom: current status: degraded -> stabilizing. Queue 300, errors 0.6%, most customers recovered. Dedicated pool absorbing sustained traffic while cloud quota pending.

alisha: follow-ups (action items):
- request immediate permanent quota increase and set monitoring for quota headroom (raj)
- change default for autoscaler.allow_fallback=true for critical routes and document rationale (maria + eng-sre)
- add a fallback health-check and automatic attachment runbook step to reduce manual ops (alisha)
- add preemptible interruption tolerance plan: maintain 20% spare on-demand capacity in each region (product + infra)

maria: opening INC ticket summary and customer comms draft. Will attach timeline and graphs.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0454 updated to status: mitigated (stabilizing) at 2026-03-14T15:53:45Z.

tom: I'm going to stay on for 20 more minutes then hand back to alisha for follow-up.

alisha: thanks. I'll pair with raj tomorrow to file quota requests and schedule runbook PR.

ops-bot: Reminder: please add a retrospective to /incidents/postmortems when incident is closed.

maria: noting communication: sent initial update to acme-inc CS team and posted status on status.redwood.com.

tom: final note: we should also test failure mode where quota blocks scale-up in staging to exercise fallback path. Adding to SRE test matrix.

alisha: ended handoff.

eng-sre: acknowledged. Closing thread when postmortem created.

ops-bot: Thread locked after 2h of inactivity."
